versions.changelog: Maintenance update: bump version to refresh on Recently Updated

Initial release: expert guidance for buying, comparing, and evaluating new energy vehicles (BEV/PHEV/EREV).

- Clear, structured workflow: collects user’s budget, needs, powertrain & use case before recommending.
- High information density: uses tables and ranked lists; no filler text.
- Prioritizes real-time data for pricing, user reviews, and cost analysis.
- Adapts to edge cases: search unavailability, total beginners, scope limits.
- Covers both new and used NEV markets, with special checks for battery health and resale factors.
